note: Both sets capture the same core facts (bolt diameter 3/8", module A/B total lengths, L3X3X1/4 profile, the 5/16" bolt callout, and the three generic PV Detail dimensions). Set B additionally captures the L3X3X1/4 member profile for MODULE B, which Set A omits, while Set A's first bolt claim stuffs the reference keynote 'S-301' into the quote. Set B's only real flaw is a duplicated Through Bolt 3/8" claim (once plain, once with S-301 as a condition). On balance B covers one more supported engineering fact and binds the keynote more cleanly.
remarks: Both sets include 'MODULE A | bolt type | 5/16"' but the text layer only shows '5/8"' entries; the 5/16" value appears to come from the image (small dimension text near the Module A detail) and cannot be confirmed from the text layer alone — worth verifying against the image at higher resolution. The three 'PV Detail | dimension' claims are generic and could be bound to the specific detail (A1 or C1) and dimensioned feature. Neither set captures the 3/8" THROUGH BOLT callouts' locations or the L3X3X1/4 count per detail.
